<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    greens=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=8:
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            greens.append(((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2, b[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]))
    out={'greens':greens}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p':
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            out['purple']=f"rows{r0}-{r1} cols{c0}-{c1}"
    return out
print('before', state())
# right green is in left socket (34,13). Move it RIGHT back to bridge, then test purple with left green in socket.
# First move right green RIGHT 3 to get back to bridge cols 21-23 -> 24-26 -> 27-29 -> 30-32
r=action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT1', state())
r=action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT2', state())
r=action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT3', state())
# now right green at cols 30-32 (bridge right end). Select left green and move it into left socket.
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':28,'col':10}]); print('selected left green', state())
r=action(['DOWN']); print('left DOWN', state())
r=action(['RIGHT']); print('left RIGHT', state())
print('final', state(), 'done', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
